org.jwcarman.codec.transform.encoding.Base32Codec

Packages that use Base32Codec
Package
Description
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.encoding
Text-safe encodings: Codec<byte[]> stages whose output is ASCII-only bytes, for payloads that must live in text columns, JSON strings, URLs or configuration.

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.aliasing(Map<Character, Character> aliases)
    The same codec, additionally reading each key of aliases as the alphabet symbol it names — Crockford's I, L → 1 and O → 0, for example.
    Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.caseInsensitive()
    The same alphabet and padding, decoding without regard to letter case: a and A both read as whichever of them is in the alphabet.
    static Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.crockford()
    Crockford's alphabet (0-9A-Z without I, L, O, U), the encoding of ULIDs: no padding, and decoding that folds case and reads I and L as 1 and O as 0.
    static Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.geohash()
    The geohash alphabet (0-9b-z without a, i, l, o): lower case, no padding, strict decoding.
    static Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.hex()
    The "extended hex" alphabet (0-9A-V) with = padding, whose encoded form sorts in the same order as the bytes it encodes — useful for sortable keys.
    static Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.of(String alphabet)
    A strict codec over alphabet with no padding.
    static Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.of(String alphabet, char pad)
    A strict codec over alphabet, padding the output to a whole group of eight symbols with pad.
    static Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.standard()
    The standard alphabet (A-Z2-7) with = padding, used by TOTP secrets and most Base32 consumers.
    static Base32Codec
    Base32Codec.zBase32()
    z-base-32 (ybndrfg8ejkmcpqxot1uwisza345h769), the alphabet chosen for ease of handwriting and reading aloud, as used by Tahoe-LAFS and Phil Zimmermann's ZRTP: lower case, no padding, strict decoding.
